verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk operation that acts on many flags, experiments, or other items in a single action. The closest items are adjacent features rather than the capability itself: the toggle endpoint switches one flag across one or more environments, drafts let you publish batched changes to a single feature, and the general REST API is a developer building block. None of these earns credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
